functions.name: packages
functions.description: Canonical package metadata qualified by account kind, stable account ID, registry type and package ID. Names are lookup context, not global identities. Organization, named-user and authenticated-user APIs preserve their distinct visibility; named-user object reads are public-only. Nullable owner summaries are qualified through the selected account endpoint. Conflict listing is a separately declared population. GitHub's pinned package schemas provide no download counter. package_access_mode records the organization, named-user or authenticated population and controls retrieval metadata; it is not part of entity identity. Linked repository ID/name are conformed from package-local evidence, preserving NULL for unlinked packages. Exact repository retrieval remains declared. Analytical enrichment through independently scoped repository listings is not approved: an accessible package may reference a public repository outside the caller's affiliated repository listing.

metrics.name: package_count
metrics.comment: Selected canonical packages; registry and owner scopes remain explicit.

reported_package_version_count.comment: Sum of current API-reported package version counters, distinct from enumerated selected version records.

functions.name: package_versions
functions.description: Canonical package version metadata at qualified package identity plus version ID. Parent package traversal establishes the stable package ID; tag/name arrays do not define identity. Organization/authenticated lists support explicit deleted versions; named-user version reads are public-only and offer no state filter. deleted_at remains optional evidence rather than an invented state flag. No pinned download counter is available. package_access_mode records the organization, named-user or authenticated population and controls retrieval metadata; it is not part of entity identity.

metrics.name: package_version_count
metrics.comment: Enumerated selected package version records, including deleted versions only where explicitly requested or returned by lookup.

metrics.name: deleted_package_version_count
metrics.comment: Returned versions carrying a deletion timestamp; absent timestamps are not proof of an active version.
